title: Reflective graph vertices do not participate in unified retrieval
wanted_capability: Reflective project-graph vertices participating in exact and text retrieval (bbox_hybrid_search and the graph tools) according to per-graph policy: source and record results retaining graph and authority identity, evidence-path expansion accompanying search results, materialized file chunks linking back to remote source vertices, and authorization filters applied before ranking and traversal expansion. Vector indexing optional and schema-directed. The reflective graph v1 deliberately ships exact-ref inspection and traversal only; this gap tracks the retrieval integration the connector program needs for its unified-retrieval milestone. Tracked by design/connectors/reflective-graph-connector-program.md.
fallback_used: Exact-ref inspection and traversal of graph vertices; text search over the materialized files only.
evidence: design/corpus/agentic-corpus/reflective-project-graph.md (no full-text or vector indexing in v1)
notes: Re-filed 2026-08-11 for the modernized connector campaign; replaces a pre-locality gap reference that was never present in any surviving store.
